name: Bili-22 dataset
description: A large-scale real-world live video comment dataset collected for evaluating non-autoregressive conditional masked live video comment generation models, considering visual, textual, time, and color information.
reputation: A specialized multimodal dataset used in live video comment generation research, with some adoption in that subcommunity but limited broader benchmark usage.
notes: Introduced alongside a Transformer-based non-autoregressive conditional masked live video comment generation model (CMVCG).
